title: ApiErrorEnvelope
description: Standard error response body for every Mirage HTTP API (Appendix F). Never includes secret values or raw untrusted intruder content.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION, UNAUTHORIZED, ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE.

details.description: Optional structured detail (e.g. field-level validation errors). Never a secret or raw intruder payload.
